fixture_name: NE Edmonton Ring Road planning-stage RSA — Canada TAC planning (real sample, Alberta Transportation 2009)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Real planning-stage safety substance: recorded sub-standard systems-service spacing (1970 m / 1670 m vs 3000 m preferred) places both service interchanges inside the system interchange functional area, with a credible weave/merge collision mechanism (rear-end and sideswipe) and congestion propagation beyond scheme limits.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Spacing figures and weaving pairs rest on recorded Stage 1 classification facts rather than invention, but the sole verbatim quote (EV-CA-003) supports only the network-wide impact rationale, not the pivotal spacing-deviation claim, so the registry-fact grounding caps at 1.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly framed as a safety concern anchored to 'preferred' spacing guidance and geometric remedies rather than asserting a mandatory compliance breach; compliance and safety concerns remain categorically distinct throughout.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific, actionable dual remedy (adopt 3000 m spacing in the next functional-plan iteration or insert collector-distributor roadways so weaving completes outside the functional area) plus verification against 2041 staging-year weave volumes, all viable at planning level.
justifications.vru_coverage: VRUs explicitly acknowledged as not applicable with sound justification (fully access-controlled ring-road mainline carrying no pedestrians or cyclists), matching the acknowledge-but-not-applicable treatment.
